facts: Back to the diff's own order, so the judge reads it as the agent made it (and so the ground truth renders identically for every agent run of a task whenever it fits: the prompt cache's shared prefix).

Everything that is the same for every agent run of a task (the prompt, the context files, the ground truth) comes first and the run's own parts last, so judge calls on one task share a cacheable prefix. The length note depends on the agent's diff, so it goes at the end.

One trace session per task and judge: the server keys OpenAI's `prompt_cache_key` on it (applyOpenRouterPromptCacheKey), so every judge call on a task (each arm, each replicate) lands on the machine that already holds its prompt, the context files and ground truth, in cache.

ai.title: BuffBench evals extract init setup logic to restore tracked files
ai.summary: The BuffBench evaluation harness in `evals/` extracts the inline dependency installation logic from `withTestRepo` into a new exported function, `runInitCommand`, in `evals/subagents/test-repo-utils.ts`. This function executes the setup command and then runs git checkout -q -- . to restore all tracked files, preventing lockfile rewrites (such as `bun.lock` or `yarn.lock`) from appearing in agent diffs. The `initCommand` fields in `eval-codebuff.json`, `eval-codebuff2.json`, `eval-manifold.json`, and `eval-manifold2.json` are updated to remove their own git checkout steps, as the new utility now handles the restore unconditionally after the install.
ai.evidence: In `evals/subagents/test-repo-utils.ts`, a new `runInitCommand` export is added that runs the `initCommand` and then executes git checkout -q -- . to restore tracked files. Correspondingly, the `initCommand` values in `evals/buffbench/eval-codebuff.json`, `eval-codebuff2.json`, `eval-manifold.json`, and `eval-manifold2.json` are changed from bun install && git checkout -- bun.lock (or the yarn equivalent) to just bun install (or yarn install).
